title: 2.3.7 Build a Switch: Animal Sounds
description: Write a switch that prints the sound an animal makes, with a default for anything else. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Create a variable to switch on
steps.instructions: Create a variable called animal and assign it one of: 'dog', 'cat', 'cow'.

steps.title: Write the switch
steps.instructions: Write a switch statement on animal. case 'dog' prints Woof, case 'cat' prints Meow, case 'cow' prints Moo, and default prints I do not know that animal. End every case with a break.

requirements.title: case 'dog' present
requirements.description: case 'dog' is directly followed by a console.log call that prints Woof

requirements.title: case 'cat' present
requirements.description: case 'cat' is directly followed by a console.log call that prints Meow

requirements.title: case 'cow' present
requirements.description: case 'cow' is directly followed by a console.log call that prints Moo

requirements.title: default label present
requirements.description: The default label is directly followed by a console.log call
